title: AI Collaboration Guide
content: How to work with AI effectively in the TYT Platform workflow.

items.title: Context & Plan First
items.why: AI needs clear scope to avoid rework.
items.what: Always share goal, scope, constraints, and the target files/paths upfront.
items.how: Provide: objective, expected outputs, touched files, and acceptance criteria before coding.

items.title: Small, Reviewable Steps
items.why: Reduces risk and makes review easy.
items.what: Prefer small patches and quick tests instead of large diffs.
items.how: Implement feature slices; run quick checks; summarize changes and next steps.

items.title: Use Automation
items.what: Use Makefile/scripts for repetitive tasks; log actions in history.

items.title: Respect Core Rules
items.what: Follow core rules on naming, ES5, folder structure, no external frameworks.
items.how: Check rules JSON before adding modules; keep entity/ generic.

items.title: Communicate Uncertainty
items.what: If blocked or unsure, ask or log assumptions.
items.how: Add to history or notes when making assumptions; propose options.
